title: Recipes
subtitle: Common form compositions
description: Edit with query+mutate, create-only, and local-only forms.
content: All recipes assume `qortex-form-react@0.1.0-alpha.0`. Query recipes need `qortex-query-react`.

sections.title: 3. Local-only form
sections.content: No query — `useForm` + your own mutator (or just read `draft`).
